name: Matsumoto Sen
source:
Sen is traveling in search of her cousin. She has a very strong idea of justice and finds it difficult to understand other forms of justice.
She is looking for a teacher to teach her the proper way of life.

When using the sword, she puts all her energy into the first blow and shouts "Chest!"
In a one-on-one she has the upper hand, but doesn't do as well against multiple opponents.
